author: Top Gear
description:
This is the most luxurious, most powerful Unimog ever built. A collaboration between Mercedes-Benz Special Trucks and Hellgeth Engineering, this monster pick-up truck is a one-off concept created to celebrate 80 years of the Unimog – but with enough interest from the rich and the famous it might make limited production too!

🚗 Mercedes x Hellgeth Unimog Concept
